svg.title: Palettes and colour
svg.desc: A colour laboratory separates perceptual measurement, palette constraints, and surface strategy.

text.tspan: Measure first. Constrain second. Choose texture last.

g.title: Start with a measured target
g.desc: The input is a concrete colour in sRGB; comparison happens after conversion to Oklab.

g.title: Distance is perceptual
g.desc: Oklab makes similar numerical distances read more like similar visible differences.

g.title: The palette is a constraint
g.desc: Filters remove unavailable, unsafe, or unwanted blocks before nearest-colour search.

g.title: Selection method changes the texture
g.desc: Nearest, ramps, gradients, and dithering trade exact local colour for continuity or pattern.

text.tspan: Colour selection is measurement under constraints
Convert the target, filter the available blocks, then choose a selection strategy for the surface.
